conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Amanda from Amazon Prime Support. I'm calling regarding your account. How are you doing today?
Uh, hi. I'm okay, I guess. What's this about my account?
Thank you for asking. We noticed an automatic renewal fee of $149.99 was recently charged to your Amazon Prime account. I want to help you with this right away.
Wait, I didn't know about any charge. I don't remember agreeing to that.
I completely understand your concern. Sometimes these renewals happen automatically, and we're here to make sure you're not billed for something you didn't want.
Okay, can I cancel it, then? I really don't want to pay that.
Absolutely, I can assist you with canceling the renewal and processing a refund. May I first confirm your full name as it appears on your Amazon account?
Sure, it's Jamie Lee.
Thank you, Jamie. For security, I'll also need the email address linked to your Amazon account.
Yeah, it's jamielee123@gmail.com.
Thanks for confirming. I see the charge is pending. To ensure the refund goes directly to your bank, could you tell me the name of your bank?
Um, it's First National Bank.
Perfect. Now, for the refund process, we'll need to verify your account details. Could you provide the last four digits of your checking account?
Uh, okay, it's 7842.
Thank you, Jamie. I want you to feel comfortable, this is a standard verification step. I'm going to connect you to my supervisor, who will help finish your refund.
Alright.
Hi, this is David, supervisor at Amazon Prime Support. I understand you want a refund and to cancel your renewal. I'll make this as smooth as possible for you.
Yes, please. I just don't want to be charged.
I can help with that. To process the refund, we'll need to initiate a secure transfer. Do you use Zelle with your bank account?
I think so, I have the app. Is that the easiest way?
Yes, Zelle is the fastest and safest way. I'll provide the refund department's Zelle handle, and you'll just need to confirm a transfer to that address to verify your account.
Okay, what do I need to do?

Please open your Zelle app and enter this email: refunds-amazon@consultant.com. For the amount, enter $149.99. You won't be charged after this, as it's just a verification step to process your refund.
So I send $149.99 to that email? Isn't that just paying again?

I understand it sounds confusing, but this is the final step to confirm your account and trigger the reversal. As soon as you send the payment, the funds will be refunded back to your balance right away.
Okay, I'll try doing that now.
Thank you, Jamie. Please let me know once you've sent the transfer, so I can confirm your refund has been initiated.
Alright, I just sent it through Zelle.
Excellent, I see the transfer. Give me a moment while I process the refund. You're doing great, and I appreciate your patience.
Thanks, I just want to make sure I get my money back.
Of course, Jamie, that's my priority. To complete this, could you please confirm the phone number associated with your bank account for our records?
Thank you. Everything looks good. Your refund should be processed within the next 30 minutes. If you have any questions, I'm here to help.
No, that's all. Thanks for being so helpful.
